special_instructions.seal_instructions: Trailers MUST be SEALED and resealed after each stop. DO NOT BREAK SEAL. Driver must have a minimum of 2 load locks to secure the load.

detention.notes: All detention is processed/approved through FourKites. Detention is on a per load basis and the carrier must get the agreed amount in writing. Carrier must notify broker 1 hour before detention begins to accrue.

fees_and_penalties.conditions: A fee of $35.00 for all fuel advances will be deducted from your invoice for each fuel advance.
Charged on loads that the carrier is responsible to supply pallets for exchange, and they do not.
Deducted from final payment for each instance that Transflo is used within each load.
If prior approval from broker is not obtained and pictures not provided immediately, carrier may risk restack fee not being reimbursed.
Lumpers will not be reimbursed without receipt.
If load is sealed and driver/carrier breaks any seal, there will be a claim charged to the carrier.

fees_and_penalties.description: Short payment for missing advance receipts
fees_and_penalties.conditions: If an advance for unloading is issued and the receipt/receipts are not provided with your invoice and BOLs, this will result in a short payment.

special_instructions.pod_requirements: All BOL and lumper receipts need to be submitted within 24 hours. Once a load is delivered in full, the carrier is responsible for immediately supplying the broker with the receiver signed BOLs. To process a normal payment (30 days), the paperwork including your invoice, BOLs and any accessorial fees related to the load needs to be submitted within 2 weeks unless otherwise noted under Special Instructions.
special_instructions.payment_terms: Normal payment: 30 days. Quick pay options available — email paperwork to quickpay@megacorplogistics.com or fax to 859-538-3281. Close out date is 30 days.
additional_notes: Driver needs food grade trailer, must precool at -10 and run the unit at -10 continuous on reefer loads unless otherwise notified by MegaCorp.
If BOL temp is other than -10, please call MegaCorp and confirm load temp.
Any Overage, short or damaged product on trailer or noted on BOL must be reported to MegaCorp immediately. Failure to do so can result in a claim.
*All loads going to Stater Bros in SAN BERNARDINO, CA must have a CARB compliant Reefer.
All accessorial charges must have prior authorization.
Truck ordered not used (TONU) fees will not be paid unless the driver has been dispatched by a MegaCorp Account manager.
Advances are limited to 40% of the line haul rate, not to exceed $3000 and no more than $1000 per 24-hour period.
All drivers are required to check call everyday (including Sat. Sun. and Holidays) between 8:00 AM and 9:00 AM eastern time.
Have drivers put Logan N Industrial Park 322 East in GPS if can't find (pickup stop special instruction)
This load is not to be dispatched or double brokered.
Immediately fax a copy of this signed confirmation to (859) 538-3347.
